entries.en: Does the device help me win?
Why don't you just sell the device, then?
Maybe not.
Experiment?
So why do it?
Just play the game.
How will that work?
Let me do it.
I won't help you cheat.
Payment
Device
Just sell it as is.
Isn't that still cheating?
You can and you will. Or your story won't stay secret for long.
Don't disappoint me, Doctor.
Oh, Commander Shepard. I didn't see you come in.
I was fired by my previous employer for giving out free medical supplies to clinics like this.
They never filed any charges. They just wanted me to leave without any fuss. But somebody must have found out. Now they're blackmailing me.
I have to give some of my medical supplies to a merchant in the markets. They expect delivery today.
Deal with him? But, won't they expose my past?
I was told to speak with a merchant named Morlan down in the markets.
I really appreciate this, Commander. Thank you.
Commander. How did things go?
Really? That's a great relief, Commander. Thank you.
I can't pay you for your help, but I can give you a discount on any supplies you purchase here.
Oh! I didn't realize things would get so.... At least it's over.
Apparently he works for someone called Banes. Sound familiar?
Banes? I wonder if he means Armistan Banes? We worked together a long time ago.
That's fine. I'm just so relieved that this is over.
Who was that on the vid? What did they want?
Give me your contact's name. I'll deal with this guy, whoever he is.
I'll make sure they don't tell anyone.
Don't worry. I'll take care of this.
He won't be bothering you any more.
I killed him.
We'll see what the captain can tell us.
I don't have time to look into it.
As expected.
Goodbye, Commander. Nice talking to you.
Let me take a look at what you have for sale.
I wish I could tell you more....
Is there anything else I can help you with, Commander?
Good luck, Commander. Be careful down there.
Commander Shepard. Any luck with my blackmailer? Did you speak with Morlan down in the markets?
Of course. I didn't mean to pressure you. Was there something else you needed?
I'm still working on it.
Yes, Commander. Is there something I can do for you?
Perhaps Captain Anderson will have some knowledge about this man.
Captain Anderson might know him.
You ever heard of someone named Banes?
He mentioned someone called Banes. Does that ring a bell?
He spoke of someone named Banes.
I believe he mentioned someone by the name of Banes.
We should follow up with Captain Anderson.
What about your captain?
I wonder if the captain knows him?
I have to give them what they want. If the board finds out about my past, I could lose my license. They'll shut my clinic down.
Last I heard, the Alliance Military was contracting him for some research in the Traverse.
I'm just glad you weren't hurt.
What can you tell me about him?
Worth looking in to.
I'll make the delivery.
Someone from my past. I can take care of it.
I see. Maybe it's better if I don't know any more.
I understand. It's my problem. I can take care of it.
I never properly thanked you for saving me from Fist's thugs, Commander.
I don't know what would have happened if you hadn't been there.
Me, too. Now, was there anything you needed?
That's good advice.
Don't worry. I'm working on it.
I'll handle this my own way.
That's very generous of you.
Every time I come in here, I see someone threatening you. Who was that?
I might be able to help you.
Maybe I can get you out of this. Tell me what they want.
They won't bother you again. I guarantee it.
You'll have to handle this one on your own.
Stick to medicine. You're not cut out for dealing with people like Fist.
Give me some time!
You need some help?
You in trouble again?
Can't deal with this now.
Not when I'm done with them.
You got in over your head.
I just wish I knew how this all started. How this thug found out about my... past.
The thug said he worked for a man named Banes. Sound familiar?
Banes.
I need those supplies for my clinic. I can't!
Commander. I'm a bit busy right now with... excuse me, please.
Hello there, Commander.
I'm Dr. Chloe Michel. Is there something I can do for you?
My parents brought me here when I was young.
My father was a medic with the Alliance.
I chose to keep the medical tradition alive, but not the military. Fixing up wounded soldiers isn't my idea of fun.
Just tell me what's going on.
Give me the details. I'll deal with this guy who's threatening you.
You're a doctor? How did you end up here, on the Citadel?
I scared him off.
Help with threats
Personal question.
I didn't tell anyone. I swear!
That was smart, Doc.
I couldn't find the proof I needed in my investigation. But I knew what was really going on. Saren's a traitor to the Council, and a disgrace to my people!
Fist is going to be waiting for us. When we hit him, we better hit him hard.
You know, we aren't the only ones going after Fist. The Shadow Broker hired a krogan bounty hunter named Wrex to take him out.
Yeah, we saw him in the bar.
Last I heard, he was at the C-Sec Academy.
What's he doing there?
Fist accused him of making threats. We brought Wrex in for a little talk. If you hurry, you can catch him at the academy before he leaves.
Now, if Garrus comes around, you stay smart. Keep your mouth shut or we'll--
Let her go!
Freeze, Garrus! One false move and I--
Ahh!
Perfect timing, Shepard. Gave me a clear shot at that bastard.
There wasn't time to think! I just reacted. I didn't mean to-- Dr. Michel? Are you hurt?
Sometimes you get lucky.
Dr. Michel? Are you hurt?
No. I'm okay. Thanks to you. All of you.
They work for Fist. They wanted to shut me up, keep me from telling Garrus about the quarian.
I think it might. Dr. Michel, tell us what happened.
A few days ago, a quarian came by my office. She'd been shot, but she wouldn't tell me who did it. I could tell she was scared, probably on the run.
She asked me about the Shadow Broker. She wanted to trade information in exchange for a safe place to hide.
I put her in contact with Fist. He's an agent for the Shadow Broker.
Not any more. Now he works for Saren, and the Shadow Broker isn't too happy about it.
Fist betrayed the Shadow Broker? That's stupid, even for him. Saren must have made him quite the offer.
That quarian must have something Saren wants. Something worth crossing the Shadow Broker to get.
I'm not sure. Like I said, she wanted to trade information for a place to hide. She didn't... wait a minute! Geth. Her information had something to do with the geth!
She did! The information she was going to trade. She said it had something to do with the geth.
She must be able to link Saren to the geth. There's no way the Council can ignore this!
This is your show, Shepard. But I want to bring Saren down as much as you do. I'm coming with you!
What were you thinking? You could've hit the hostage!
You took him down clean.
I know those men threatened you. But if you tell us who they work for, we can protect you.
Why were they threatening you? Who do they work for?
Does this have anything to do with the investigation into Saren?
What quarian?
Where is she now?
What else can you tell me about the quarian?
She must have something that proves he's a traitor. Did the quarian mention anything about Saren? Or the geth?
You can come along, but I'll be watching you!
A krogan might come in handy.
We can handle this on our own. Let's go.
It was a big risk.
Nice shot.
We can protect you.
Who were those men?
Quarian?
Where'd she go?
Evidence.
We need to find her!
